text: True or False: The Geach–Kaplan sentence 'Some critics admire only one another' cannot be expressed in first-order logic in the vocabulary {Critic, Admires} without quantifying over a set.
explanation: Kaplan showed, by a Löwenheim–Skolem-style argument, that no first-order sentence in {Critic, Admires} alone is equivalent to it; capturing it needs a second-order/set quantifier — or, in plural logic, the plural quantifier ∃xx. So the statement is true.
